title: BFWP telemetry (single reading) v1
description: All values are converted to engineering units on the device. 1 flow pulse = 1 gallon.

mode.description: Publishing cadence in effect: active = 1 s, idle = 60 s (+ report-on-change)

psi.description: Well pressure, psi gauge. null while sensor faulted.

amps.description: Pump motor current, A RMS. Upper bound provisional until the current sensor is chosen. null while faulted.

gal_total.description: Cumulative gallons (= cumulative meter pulses). Never resets.

gpm.description: Flow rate from the interval between pulses; see 03-sensors-and-units.md

psi_v.description: Optional. Measured pressure-sensor voltage at the sensor (before any divider), for recalibration.

amps_v.description: Optional. Measured current-sensor voltage at the sensor (before any divider), for recalibration.
